name: addManaToActions
signature: export function addManaToActions(effect: Extract<Effect, { do: 'add-mana' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 106.4 the mana pool empties as a step ends
CR 605.1 mana abilities do not use the stack
layerOrTiming: resolution of a mana ability; the pool it feeds empties at end of step
contract: Parses the mana string with P16 and never with its own regex, so one grammar covers costs and production.
GameState carries no mana pool and GameAction has no member that adds to one. This primitive therefore returns a deferred line naming exactly what would be added, and emits no action.
It must NOT invent a state write, and must NOT return an empty result: an unrepresentable effect that says nothing is the silent no-op the engine exists to prevent.
An unparseable mana string is reported as unparseable, not silently treated as zero mana.

evidence.claim: mana production is a checked Mana object, not an integer

assertions.expect: no actions, exactly one deferred line naming one green mana
the deferred line names two colourless
a deferred line that says it could not be parsed, not a silent zero
